AI Notes.value: Artist-duo practice (Andrea Anner, b.1985, Zurich; Thibault Brevet, b.1988, Lyon), founded 2018, based in Zurich and Marseille. Both trained at ECAL Lausanne (Anner: BA Visual Communication ZHdK 2008, MA Art Direction/Type Design ECAL 2012; Brevet: BA Graphic Design ECAL 2012, MA Visual Arts ECAL 2015). Their practice combines software programming, electronics, mechanical engineering and precision machining to make kinetic and interactive robotic installations exploring human-machine interaction. Swiss Design Award 2021; CERN Arts residency 2022-23; Atelier Luma residency; exhibited at ZKM, New Museum NY, Venice Architecture Biennale, Ars Electronica, and active in 2026 (Shenzhen show). Senior/established practice at roughly 8 years; Autonomy 4 as a self-directed studio with international institutional reach, though they do hands-on execution rather than pure direction.
